newsitem.title: UK: Cargill says works for Nov IPE gas oil delivery.
newsitem.headline: Cargill says works for Nov IPE gas oil delivery.

text.p: Cargill Investor Services (CIS) said on Wednesday it was working with the IPE to ensure an orderly delivery of the November IPE gas oil contract.

Lori Johnson, a CIS spokesperson, said by telephone: "CIS, on behalf of its customer, is actively working with the IPE to ensure an orderly delivery process that is in full compliance with the spirit and rules of the IPE." She added: "Our intent is still to take delivery."
CIS's customer is Geneva-based Cargill International SA.

A duel between the main short, Monte Carlo-based AIC, and the main long, Cargill International SA, on the November contract involves the bulk of the record 865,1000 tonnes delivery due between November 16-30 on the Rotterdam region barge market.
AIC has said Cargill has been excessively slow to take delivery between November 16-20, the first of three five-day delivery periods which ends at midnight on Wednesday.
Traders have said Cargill had established a large long position in November gas oil futures, betting that AIC, which has a large short position, would not be able to deliver into its commitments.
